title: A lower bound for the distance between CM points on Shimura curves
summary: In this paper, we establish a quantitative Diophantine approximation result for complex multiplication (CM) points on Shimura curves. Specifically, we prove a lower bound for the distance between a sequence of CM points $P_n$ converging to a fixed CM point $P$ on a Shimura curve $X(D,1)$ in terms of the discriminant of the endomorphism rings of $P_n$. The proof exploits the complex geometry of the Fuchsian uniformization, the explicit matrix representation of the underlying quaternion algebra, and Liouville's inequality.
